EMPLOYEES.SUBTITLE: Manage your team members, their access and permissions

FORM.NAME: Name
FORM.PRIMARY_HINT: Click the ⭐ next to a branch to mark it as the employee's primary branch. The primary branch is used by attendance reports.
FORM.TERMINATION_HINT: Leave empty if the employee is currently employed.
FORM.PASSWORD_MIN: Password must be at least 8 characters
FORM.PASSCODE_IN_USE: This pass code is already being used
FORM.EMAIL_ALREADY_EXISTS: This email is already registered as an employee

FORM.KEEP_EMPTY_PASSWORD: Keep it empty to not change the password

FORM.KEEP_EMPTY_MSR: Keep it empty to not change the MSR

FORM.SYSTEM_ACCESS_HINT: This employee signs in to the portal or the POS.
FORM.SYSTEM_ACCESS_OFF_HINT: No login. The record still holds attendance and HR details.

INTRO.TITLE: 👋 The employee form
INTRO.BODY: A quick walkthrough of each section, in the order you'd normally fill it in. Use the buttons or ← / → to move, and Esc to leave at any point.

SYSTEM_ACCESS.TITLE: 1. System access
SYSTEM_ACCESS.BODY: Turn this off for someone who works here but never signs in — a warehouse or kitchen worker. They still get a record, attendance and HR details; they just get no credentials, no roles and no privilege set.

BASIC.TITLE: 2. Basic information
BASIC.BODY: The employee's name, plus the credentials for however they sign in. Which credential fields appear depends on the roles you pick in the next step.

EMAIL.TITLE: 3. Email
EMAIL.BODY: The address a Cloud Admin signs in with. It's checked as you type: if it already belongs to an InvoCloud user, you'll be offered the invitation flow instead.

PASSWORD.TITLE: 4. Password
PASSWORD.BODY: At least 8 characters. When editing someone later, leave this alone to keep their current password — you only fill it in to change it.

ROLES.TITLE: 5. Employee roles
ROLES.BODY: Cloud Admin signs in to this portal with an email and password. POS User signs in at the till with a pass code. Driver is an extra flag for deliveries, not a sign-in method. At least one sign-in role stays selected.

ACCESS.TITLE: 6. Access & permissions
ACCESS.BODY: The privilege set decides what this person can see and do. The MSR field holds a swipe-card id, if your tills use them.

IMAGE.TITLE: 7. Photo
IMAGE.BODY: Pick a photo from the media library. It shows on the employee list and at the till.

BRANCHES.TITLE: 8. Branch assignment
BRANCHES.BODY: Choose every branch this person works at. One of them is the primary branch, marked with a star — that's the one their till prices and services are pulled from.

PRIMARY_STAR.TITLE: 9. The primary branch
PRIMARY_STAR.BODY: Click a star to make that branch primary. Only one can be, and it matters: the till uses the primary branch to decide which prices and services this employee gets.

EMPLOYMENT.TITLE: 10. Employment
EMPLOYMENT.BODY: Hire date, and a termination date once someone leaves. Leaving the termination date empty means they're still employed.

HR_PROFILE.TITLE: 11. Personal details
HR_PROFILE.BODY: The person behind the account: contact details, nationality, address, emergency contacts and dependants. Required fields are marked; the rest can be filled in over time.

HR_EMPLOYMENT.TITLE: 12. Employment details
HR_EMPLOYMENT.BODY: Department, position, manager and contract terms. Department and position offer the values already used elsewhere in your company — pick one, or type a new one.

PROFILE.NAME_AR_HINT: Used on official documents and payroll files.
PROFILE.EMPLOYEE_NUMBER_HINT: HR's own number for this employee — not the POS pass code.
PROFILE.PERSONAL_EMAIL_HINT: Kept after the work email is closed.
PROFILE.DEPENDENTS_HINT: Used later for insurance and family visas.

EMPLOYMENT.SENIORITY_DATE_HINT: Defaults to the hire date; differs on a rehire or a transfer.
EMPLOYMENT.LOOKUP_HINT: Pick a value already in use, or type a new one.

VALIDATION.FORMAT: Check the format of this value

INVITE.TITLE: Invite employee
INVITE.NEVER_HINT: The invitation stays active until you revoke it.
INVITE.USER_NOT_FOUND: No InvoCloud user was found for this email

SCHEDULE.TITLE: Employee Schedule
SCHEDULE.ADD_NOTES: Add notes about this time off…
SCHEDULE.SHIFT_INVALID_TIME: A shift's start time is on or after its end time
SCHEDULE.SHIFT_INVALID_TIME_CTX: A shift's start time is on or after its end time for {{day}} in week {{week}}
SCHEDULE.NO_EMPLOYEES_TEXT: Add employees to this branch to manage their schedules.
SCHEDULE.DELETE_SHIFT_CONFIRM_MSG: This shift will be removed from the schedule.
SCHEDULE.DELETE_TIMEOFF_CONFIRM_MSG: This time off will be removed from the schedule.
SCHEDULE.ROSTER_HINT: The team roster shows availability for bookings and is not linked to your business standard opening hours.

MY_ACCOUNT.TITLE: My Account
MY_ACCOUNT.SECURITY_DESC: Update your sign-in credentials. Turn on a toggle to change that credential — leave it off to keep the current one.
MY_ACCOUNT.PASSWORD_HINT: Password must be at least 6 characters
MY_ACCOUNT.PASSCODE_HINT: Passcode must be at least 4 digits
MY_ACCOUNT.TWO_FACTOR_HINT: Require a one-time code from your authenticator app when signing in

PRIVILEGES.TITLE: Privileges
PRIVILEGES.SUBTITLE: Reusable permission sets you can assign to employees
PRIVILEGES.NAME: Name
PRIVILEGES.ACCESS_HINT: Toggle the features and actions this privilege set can access

ATTENDANCE.TITLE: Attendance Log
ATTENDANCE.SUBTITLE: Clock-in / clock-out records for your team
ATTENDANCE.SECTION_ORIGINAL_DESC: The clock-in / clock-out times captured by the system (read-only)
ATTENDANCE.SECTION_ADJUST_DESC: Override the recorded times if a correction is needed
ATTENDANCE.ADJ_CLOCKED_IN_HINT: Leave empty to keep the recorded clock-in time
ATTENDANCE.ADJ_CLOCKED_OUT_HINT: Leave empty to keep the recorded clock-out time
ATTENDANCE.BULK_HINT: Set clock-in and/or clock-out for all selected records. Leave a field empty to leave it unchanged.

DOCUMENTS.TITLE: Documents
DOCUMENTS.EMPTY: No documents recorded for this employee yet.
DOCUMENTS.WARNINGS: Saved, with the following left outstanding

ERR.NOT_DEPLOYED: This feature is not available on the server
ERR.NOT_DEPLOYED_HINT: The endpoint returned 404. The HR routes may not be deployed to this environment yet.
ERR.NOT_PERMITTED: You do not have permission to do that
ERR.NOT_PERMITTED_HINT: HR permissions must be granted explicitly. Check the employee's privilege set for the Documents permissions.
ERR.NO_STORAGE_HINT: The server has no document storage bucket set. Files cannot be uploaded until it is configured.
ERR.UPLOAD_REJECTED: The server did not receive the file
ERR.UPLOAD_REJECTED_HINT: The request reached the server but no file arrived with it — usually the upload middleware or the form field name rather than the file itself.
ERR.TYPE_REJECTED: That file type is not accepted

ASSETS.TITLE: Assets
ASSETS.EMPTY: Nothing has been issued to this employee.
ASSETS.NO_CATALOG: The asset catalogue could not be loaded, so the pickers are empty and the rules about return details are not applied here. Saving still works — the server will say what it does not accept.
ASSETS.TAG_HINT: Unique across the whole company — one tag, one physical item.
ASSETS.VALUE_HINT: Leave blank if not recorded. Blank is not the same as zero.

LEAVE.NO_PERIOD: The period this covers is unknown
LEAVE.NO_BALANCE: No leave balance could be loaded for this employee.
LEAVE.PENDING_COUNTS: Pending requests are already counted as used — the remaining figure reflects them, not just approved leave.
LEAVE.FALLBACK_WARNING: This employee's leave year is set to run from their hire anniversary, but no hire date is recorded. The figures below cover the calendar year instead, which is probably not the right twelve months.
LEAVE.BASIS_UNKNOWN_WARNING: The server did not say which leave year these figures cover. Treat them as indicative.
LEAVE.WARNINGS: Saved, with the following left outstanding
LEAVE.NO_SELF_APPROVAL: You cannot approve your own leave request.
LEAVE.NO_SUGGESTION: The server could not suggest a figure for these dates.
LEAVE.EXCLUDES_HOLIDAYS: The suggestion excludes rest days but not public holidays — no holiday calendar is configured. Enter the figure that was actually agreed.

PERFORMANCE.NO_CATALOG: The performance catalogue could not be loaded. Statuses and ratings will be blank, and the rules about who may write what are not applied here — the server still enforces them.
PERFORMANCE.OVERRIDDEN: This score was overridden by hand
PERFORMANCE.NO_REASON: No reason was recorded for the override.
PERFORMANCE.CALIBRATION_NOTE: The computed score is kept as it is. This records an override alongside it.

TRAINING.NAME: Course
TRAINING.EXPIRY_HINT: Feeds the reminder engine. No expiry status is computed for trainings, so only the date is shown.
